title: Compiled fresh-bound routine for toggle->confirm and modal->act: six-gate scripted qualification + live TypeSafe COMP+CR arm on binary R

advances.E2: R2-10 live COMP toggle/modal provider decisions 434.8 / 462.4 ms (88-89% of T) are UNTESTED. This lane qualifies their deletion (G1-G6) and measures the live COMP+CR decomposition with every invocation in the denominator.
advances.E3: If the routine survives, the wave-5 composed configuration includes compiled replay for toggle/modal. The paired live BASE vs COMP+CR S stays BLOCKED on budget (needs >= 120 reached).

binary_R.name: cua-driver-r2-10-8f3a646b4
binary_R.rehash_and_version: inside every session (harness refuses on mismatch)

source.harness_basis: R2-07b compiled_routine.py and R2-10 r2_10_browser.py copied by path, unchanged, from exp/r2-10-composition-20261002 030f6bdbf (harness/src/r2-10-composition-2026-10-02/); new: compiled_routine_tm.py, fixture_tm.py, fault_transport_tm.py, r2_07c.py (salvaged from the uncommitted attempt-1 harness after review, then edited as listed in deviations_from_attempt_1)
deviations_from_attempt_1: training invocation = R2-10 rb10.step_loop unchanged (guard off for toggle/modal, visual_mode auto) instead of the attempt-1 continuation
guarded continuation (fallback) uses visual_mode auto (as the R2-10 step loop) plus the role+name uniqueness filter
fresh loopback fixture servers per invocation (artifact is port-agnostic)
Driver result tap: every mutation row keeps the Driver's own status/effect/code (effect=refused evidence)
TypeSafe model id captured from SystemOneResponse.model (no bodies)
timing plan starts with one training+compile+admission per class in the timed store (G6 costs under EXCLUSIVE)
live warm invocation without an admitted routine retrains once, then the class stops (NOT_RUN no_admitted_routine)

artifact.holds: logical role+name targets; preconditions (toggle: page loopback origin + path, checkbox checked_state == false, Confirm uniquely present; modal: Open control present and unique, 'Confirm choice' absent = modal not open); depends_on; expected outcome; postcondition of step 1 checked by step 2; fallback point (guarded continuation before each mutation)
artifact.never_holds: refs, ids, epochs, snapshot ids, pids, window ids, coordinates, capture ids, tokens, capabilities, session labels
artifact.authority_check: compiled_routine_tm.check_artifact_authority_tm (forbidden keys anywhere, key whitelist, forbidden value patterns, floats) on every compiled artifact; verify_artifacts.py re-runs it on every artifact in raw/
artifact.binding: every mutation binds to a ref from the routine's own fresh semantic_v2 observation, taken after the previous mutation; browser_ref_stale gets exactly one rebind; a possibly landed click is reconciled before anything else and never replayed; unresolved stays unknown
artifact.service: none: in-process caller-side artifact per class; no engine, registry, router or service

arms.COMP: R2-10 COMP for toggle/modal, unchanged (rb10.one): feedback OFF, 10 ms completion poll, compiled validators, CUA_DRIVER_EXP_ADMISSION_TOOLS_CACHE=1, phase trace on; step loop decides each click (scripted chooser in Phase S)
arms.COMP_CR: COMP + compiled replay: warm invocation replays the admitted artifact, 0 decisions; failed precondition -> guarded continuation from the current state (decisions counted)

oracle: jev-use/#24 fixture server journal and state (toggle: checked true; modal: opened and modal true), read every 2 ms in process by an independent harness thread (rb10.Sampler), never the runner's report. T_oracle = first expected-state sample at/after the return of the last accepted mutation minus the send of the first semantic observation (R2-10 browser_row). completion mutations counted from the server journal.
route_and_producer: route from launcher receipts: two browser_click with input_route dom_event, receipt route dom, and a click.cdp_send mark inside each click window; decision producers from receipts (decided events + provider ledger lines per trial); a warm invocation must show 0 decided events and 0 provider ledger lines

phase_S.provider: scripted chooser (jev-use choose_mock_for_task); 0 provider requests; TYPESAFE_API_KEY not forwarded

blocks.G: traingate: 1 training + compile + clean-reset admission per class (store 'scripted'); SHARED lock
blocks.N: negatives: 5 rounds x (N1,N2,N3,N4a,N4b,N5,N6,N7 x 2 classes + N8 OOD x 3 [toggle on fill, toggle on modal, modal on toggle]) = 95 cells, store 'scripted'; SHARED lock, <= 10 cells per acquisition
blocks.W: N-W2: B-02 control (rb10.nw2_one, unchanged) with the COMP admission knob, 5 per class = 10 cells; SHARED
blocks.R: G5 reconcile on action 2 via fault_transport_tm (R2-05/R2-07 seam): applied_ack_lost 5, delayed_after_first_unchanged_read 5, withheld_unresolved 3 per class = 26 cells; SHARED
blocks.T: timing under bin/quiet-timed (EXCLUSIVE): 1 training(+compile+admission) per class into store 'timed', then 30 rounds; round r: class order alternates every 2 rounds, arm order AB (COMP first) on even r, BA on odd r
blocks.C6: costs under bin/quiet-timed (EXCLUSIVE): 5 x N7 per class (fallback cost) + 5 x N8 cross-page per class (wrong-match cost), store 'timed'

gates.G1: per class, every training invocation (blocks G, T and Phase L) independently verified (outcome verified, oracle_exact_match, exactly 1 completion mutation), compiled without error, authority scan clean
gates.G2: per class, every clean-reset admission replay verified with 0 fallback, 0 decisions, every mutation fresh
gates.G3: 100% of ACCEPTED mutations in every COMP_CR cell (all blocks, both phases) fresh per the launcher Driver-call receipts (ref minted by the latest observation, no mutation since); every non-fresh dispatch attempt (N4b by construction) refused with effect=refused

G4.N1_renamed: routine dispatches nothing after the failed precondition (toggle: step 0 requires_present; modal: step 1 target_not_found); 0 completion mutations; not reported verified
G4.N3_duplicate: routine fails precondition (ambiguous); 0 ambiguous dispatches = 0 completion mutations (both duplicates fire the completion event) and the continuation drops the non-unique candidate
G4.N4a_node_replaced: dom_replace == replaced between bind and dispatch of action 2; first action-2 dispatch refused browser_ref_stale with Driver effect=refused; exactly one rebind (one extra observation); verified; exactly 1 completion mutation
G4.N4b_superseding_snapshot: a second observation taken between bind and dispatch of action 2; verified with exactly 1 completion mutation; any refusal has effect=refused followed by exactly one rebind; no accepted non-fresh dispatch
G4.N5_session_label_replaced: label replaced before step 2; old target capability refused in the new session (discriminating control); fresh prepare+bind; verified; exactly 1 completion mutation; all accepted mutations fresh
G4.N6_unexpected_dialog: dialog_opened journal event present (discriminating); routine dispatches nothing after action 1; 0 completion mutations; not reported verified
G4.N7_precondition_satisfied: routine dispatches nothing (fails at step 0); guarded continuation verified from the current state with exactly 1 completion mutation and exactly 1 accepted mutation in the trial (0 double toggles / 0 re-opens)
G4.N8_OOD: 0 accepted mutations in the trial (routine and continuation) and 0 completion mutations
G4.N_W2: stale action refused (effect refused, browser_ref_stale), 0 mutations from the stale action, fresh re-derivation verified

gates.G5: every cell fault_fired; applied_ack_lost and delayed rows verified_by_reconcile; withheld_unresolved verified_by_reconcile or unknown; per cell <= 1 completion mutation after harness release (0 duplicates) and 0 mutations dispatched after the transport failure
gates.G6: training (T_oracle of each training invocation), compile (ms), admission (T_oracle), warm (T_oracle), fallback (N7 C6 cells: T_oracle + decisions) and wrong-match (N8 C6 cells: time first observation -> routine end, decisions) reported separately with all-invocation denominators; reported, no threshold
gates.timing_non_regression: per class, paired diff T_oracle(COMP_CR warm) - T_oracle(COMP) over the 30 rounds; median diff with 95% seeded paired bootstrap CI (b01_analysis.paired_diff, seed 20261002, 10000 resamples); gate: CI upper bound <= +2.0 ms; also report S = median T_COMP / median T_COMP_CR with CI. Validity: every timing cell verified (failures stay in the denominator and fail the gate)

phase_L.precondition: Phase S passes every gate (G1-G6 + timing non-regression) in both classes
phase_L.provider: TypeSafe as configured by the jev-use runner (TypeSafeClient defaults; model id recorded from SystemOneResponse.model); key forwarded by NAME only (CUA_SESSION_FORWARD_SECRETS=TYPESAFE_API_KEY)

budget.guard: harness counts each HTTP attempt before sending and refuses once either cap would be exceeded; before each live invocation it stops if reached+4 or attempts+4 would exceed a cap; invocations not run are NOT_RUN (budget) and stay in the denominators
budget.ledger: raw/provider-ledger.jsonl: host, path, status, request-id presence + sha256/16, latency, trial; no bodies or headers

phase_L.shakedown: optional: one live toggle training invocation (+ compile + admission) under the SHARED lock, counted toward the cap, excluded from Phase L results
phase_L.plan: under bin/quiet-timed (EXCLUSIVE): 30 rounds; class order alternates per round; round 0 = training (ordinary R2-10 step loop, 2 decisions) + compile + clean-reset admission per class; rounds 1-29 = warm compiled invocations (0 decisions expected); fallbacks run the guarded continuation with live decisions, counted; fresh Driver, Chromium and fixture servers per invocation; loadavg per invocation; every invocation kept

metrics.warm_validity: verified (independent oracle, exactly 1 completion mutation), route compiled only, two dom_event clicks with click.cdp_send, 0 decided events, 0 provider ledger lines; denominator = 29 per class incl. failures and NOT_RUN
metrics.amortized: mean_all = (sum T_oracle over the 30 invocations + compile_ms + T_oracle(admission)) / 30; ratio_of_means = mean_all / mean_warm; T_training reported separately (n=1 per class)
metrics.decisions_per_invocation: total decided events / 30 (training and fallbacks included)
metrics.decomposition: R2-10 e2_components (b01 decompose + B-02 taxonomy) mean over warm invocations and over all 30 invocations; share of mean T_runner

phase_L.not_compared: Phase L T is never compared with R2-10 live numbers as an S (different session, host state, no paired BASE)

disposition_rules.KEEP: G1-G6 and timing non-regression pass in both classes AND Phase L warm-invocation validity 100% (every failure in the denominator) AND 0 E4 violations (routine-attributable stale dispatch, ambiguous dispatch, duplicate, unverified success, blind replay) AND no authority field in any artifact -> the live toggle/modal provider-decision component in COMP+CR is DELETED (KEEP); training and fallback costs shown separately
disposition_rules.KILL: any routine-attributable stale or ambiguous dispatch, any duplicate completion mutation, or any unverified success
disposition_rules.REVISE: scripted gates pass but Phase L fallbacks > 10% of warm invocations or the cap truncates Phase L; report the revised scope

e4_accounting: per cell: caller_stale_dispatch = accepted non-fresh mutations; duplicate = completion mutations > 1; unverified_success = reported verified without oracle_exact_match; refusal_returned_as_success; blind_replay (R2-10 blind_replays) + dispatches_after_unknown
failed_session_blocks: a chunk whose private session fails to start (e.g. Xvfb/openbox cannot open the display, every browser exits before DevTools) is kept in raw/ as a failed session block, excluded from row evaluation, and re-run under a new id

excluded.attempt_1: aborted attempt 1 (no commit): SHARED mock shakedowns shake-a, a2, o2, o12, o22 (0 TypeSafe requests) excluded; disclosed
excluded.attempt_2_shakedown: mock shakedown blocks K (failed session start) and Kb (34 cells) before this PREREG; excluded from results

claim_boundary: kvnloo/cua#24 toggle/modal pages, binary R, TypeSafe as configured by the jev-use runner (model id recorded), one host, private Xvfb. Paired live BASE vs COMP+CR S is BLOCKED (budget: needs >= 120 reached).
